Question 13
?

A linear system of ODEs has an equilibrium at x∗. One of the nullclines of the system has the equation y=2x−3 in the corresponding phase space. The system is then shifted using u=x−x∗. Which of the following is guaranteed to be a nullcline of the shifted system?

a
y=2x
b
y=−3x+2
c
y=3x
d
y=2x+3
e
y=−2x
Submit
